request.name: Brief
request.description: Summarize only text provided by the user and identify its main points.

constraints.statement: Use only text provided by the user; do not fetch external data.

Summarize only text provided by the user

inputFacts.missingBehavior: Ask the user to provide the text to summarize.

response.goal: Summarize text provided by the user and identify its main points.

responsibilities.statement: Summarize the text provided by the user.

source.quote: Summarize only text provided by the user

responsibilities.statement: Identify the main points of the provided text.

procedure: If no text is provided, ask the user to paste it.
Read the provided text.
Summarize it and list its main points.
outputExpectations: A concise summary followed by the main points of the provided text.
acceptanceCriteria: The summary uses only the provided text.
The main points are identified.

request.name: Editor

constraints.statement: Do not invent facts or claim that the text was published.

inputFacts.name: text
inputFacts.missingBehavior: Ask the user to provide the text to rewrite.

response.goal: Rewrite user-provided text for clarity while preserving its factual meaning.

responsibilities.statement: Rewrite user-provided text for clarity.
Preserve the factual meaning of the text.

procedure: If no text is supplied, ask the user for it.
Rewrite the text for clarity.
Check that every fact from the original is preserved.
Return the rewritten text.
outputExpectations: The rewritten text with the same factual meaning.
acceptanceCriteria: No facts are added, removed or changed.

request.name: Invoice Check
request.description: Check arithmetic in an invoice supplied by the user and report discrepancies; do not pay or modify it.

constraints.statement: Never pay or modify the invoice.

source.quote: do not pay or modify it

inputFacts.name: invoice
inputFacts.missingBehavior: Ask the user to provide the invoice figures.

response.goal: Check the arithmetic of an invoice supplied by the user and report discrepancies.

responsibilities.statement: Check the arithmetic in the invoice supplied by the user.

source.quote: Check arithmetic in an invoice supplied by the user

responsibilities.statement: Report any discrepancies found.

procedure: If invoice figures are missing, ask the user to provide them.
Recalculate line totals, subtotals, taxes and the grand total.
Compare each recalculated figure with the stated figure.
Report each discrepancy with the expected and stated values.
outputExpectations: A list of discrepancies, or a statement that the arithmetic is consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: Every reported discrepancy shows the expected and stated values.

request.name: Minutes
request.description: Extract decisions and action items from a transcript supplied by the user, without creating tasks.

constraints.statement: Do not create tasks or tickets.
Record an owner only when the transcript states one.

source.quote: from a transcript supplied by the user

requirements.need: Extract decisions and action items from supplied text.

inputFacts.name: transcript
inputFacts.missingBehavior: Ask the user to provide the meeting transcript.

response.goal: Extract decisions and action items from a transcript supplied by the user.

responsibilities.statement: Extract the decisions from the supplied transcript.
Extract the action items from the supplied transcript.

source.quote: action items from a transcript supplied by the user

procedure: If no transcript is supplied, ask the user for it.
Identify each decision.
Identify each action item with its stated owner, or mark the owner as unknown.
Return the decisions and the action items as two lists.
outputExpectations: Two lists: decisions, and action items with their owner or unknown.
acceptanceCriteria: Only decisions and action items stated in the transcript are listed.
Owners that are not stated are marked unknown.
